Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent was tasked with identifying the artist of the 2003 album "The Boy Next Door." The search results included multiple sources stating "Jane Monheit" as the artist, but also an entry from Discogs contradicting this by listing "Stacey Kent" as the artist for "The Boy Next Door." The WebSurfer focused only on the entry for Jane Monheit without addressing the conflicting information directly evident from the Discogs entry. This led to the overlooking of Stacey Kent as a possible correct artist. This mistake aligns with the error pattern of ignoring contradictory evidence that directly contradicts the assumed conclusion in Step 1.
